record_scope_reconstruction: Passenger/private-car access on Mae Sot–Myawaddy Friendship Bridge I over the Moei. Cargo operated through Bridge II and must not be attached to this phase.

source_checks.finding: Myanmar ministry explicitly names Bridge I reopening January 12 and its private-car/passenger terms; it says border trade had used Bridge II during closure. Its March 23 wording does not override accepted onset qualification.
Thai government locates Bridge I on Highway 105 and gives 1997 opening and January 12 2023 restoration.

sites.name: Mae Sot–Myawaddy Friendship Bridge I
sites.coordinate_method: Mean of unique vertices in fresh OSM named feature outline
sites.precision: Approximate crossing area, about 100 m; not the historical barrier footprint
sites.evidence_note: Named OSM bridge footprint on Moei River; Thai government description fixes Bridge I to Highway 105 and 1997 opening, separately from cargo Bridge II.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Passenger/private-car access on Mae Sot–Myawaddy Friendship Bridge I over the Moei. Cargo operated through Bridge II and must not be attached to this phase.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: The two-day onset range preserves contradictory reports. Ordinary passenger/private-car scope excludes Bridge II freight and early diversions; border-pass conditions remained after reopening.
